desc: Athlon designed the Talos family of spotting scopes with good optical quality and ease of use in mind. The Talos spotting scope features their fully multi-coated lenses and K9 prisms with silver coating. They bring great clarity and brightness within the reach of all enthusiasts. The light-weight composite chassis is fog proof, waterproof, and filled with nitrogen gas to prevent internal fogging and promote better thermal stability. The product comes with a table-top tripod and soft case allowing you to carry the spotting scope and tripod in one package.
